_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Misadventure on the Sea#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある {p} の酒場を訪ねる

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#001.dst: よう兵隊さん！何にする？
Misadventure on the Sea#001.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#002.src: I'll take {~} {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#002.dst: {p} ウイスキーを {~} 杯。俺の分と、こいつの分だ。
Misadventure on the Sea#002.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#004.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#004.dst: で…町でお前を見かけたぜ。日誌を届けてやった時、あの男がえらく喜んでたな。
Misadventure on the Sea#004.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#005.dst: {p} ウイスキー {~} 杯、お待ち！
Misadventure on the Sea#005.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#006.dst: で…兵隊さんよ。俺と海に出る気はねえか？あの Seaskipper より上等な船があるんだ！
Misadventure on the Sea#006.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#007.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#007.dst: 海の探検に興味があると思ってな！
Misadventure on the Sea#007.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#008.dst: 波止場で待ってるぜ。心配すんな、船は見りゃすぐ分かる！
Misadventure on the Sea#008.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#009.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Honip と合流する

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#010.dst: 来たな！準備はいいか？ついて来い、船はこっちだ！
Misadventure on the Sea#010.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#011.dst: 見ろよ…見事だろ！Seaskipper のボロ船よりずっといい！
Misadventure on the Sea#011.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#012.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#012.dst: で、何を待ってる？乗りな！
Misadventure on the Sea#012.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#013.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#013.dst: じゃあ決まりだ、冒険に出発だぜ！
Misadventure on the Sea#013.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#014.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#014.dst: しっかりつかまれ、波に乗るぞ。
Misadventure on the Sea#014.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#015.dst: あー…言っとくが、実は船を操るのは初めてでな…
Misadventure on the Sea#015.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#016.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#016.dst: でも大して難しくなさそうだ、ちょいと左に…
Misadventure on the Sea#016.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#017.dst: ふむ、今日海に出てるのは俺たちだけじゃないらしい。
Misadventure on the Sea#017.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#018.src: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#018.dst: あいつら、ちょっと真正面から来すぎじゃねえか？
Misadventure on the Sea#018.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#019.dst: 舵を切ろうとしてるんだが、びくともしねえ…
Misadventure on the Sea#019.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#021.dst: 不運なのは…「お前」だがな！
Misadventure on the Sea#021.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#022.dst: よう、やっと目が覚めたか。
Misadventure on the Sea#022.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#023.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#023.dst: 正直、あんなのに引っかかるなんて信じられねえ。まとめてやるよ…
Misadventure on the Sea#023.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#024.dst: めちゃくちゃ怪しい海賊が近づいてきて、酒をおごり、怪しい船に案内する。
Misadventure on the Sea#024.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.dst: 普通の奴ならその時点で引き返す。なのにお前は？飛び乗った！ってわけで、もう俺たちから逃げられねえ。
Misadventure on the Sea#025.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#026.dst: 手短に言う。この船は修繕が必要で、お前にやってもらう。
Misadventure on the Sea#026.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#027.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#027.dst: なぜかって？お前は兵隊だろ！命令に従うのが仕事だ！とにかく、俺たちの物を掃除してもらう。ほら、出ろ。
Misadventure on the Sea#027.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#029.dst: 下がれって言っただろ！
Misadventure on the Sea#029.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
Misadventure on the Sea#031.dst: 中には骸骨がけっこうあってな、わざわざ捨てたこともねえんだ！
Misadventure on the Sea#031.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#032.dst: さあ行け、乾いた血用のスポンジもやる。骸骨はそれでぶっ叩きゃいい！
Misadventure on the Sea#032.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#033.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#033.dst: 用があれば甲板にいる。それと、あー、船倉には入るな。ネズミがひどくてな。
Misadventure on the Sea#033.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#034.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#034.dst: あと、手下のためにも、もう少し協力的になってくれねえか？この薬も無限にあるわけじゃねえんだ。
Misadventure on the Sea#034.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: 船内の死体を掃除する。同時に脱出の手がかりを探す。-掃除した死体: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#036.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#036.dst: よう、お前が俺たちの専属護衛か？
Misadventure on the Sea#036.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#038.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#038.dst: そのはしごは船倉に通じてるが、今は鍵がかかってる…ネズミがひどくてな。
Misadventure on the Sea#038.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: Pep はまさにお宝だよな？お前も世話してくれて嬉しいぜ！
Misadventure on the Sea#039.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#040.dst: Honip はニワトリを飼ってる、変だろ？
Misadventure on the Sea#040.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#041.dst: きっと自分の島にいた変な奴から思いついたんだろうな…
Misadventure on the Sea#041.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#042.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#042.dst: 何？あいつの一番大事なニワトリを殺した？変わった奴だな、兵隊さん。
Misadventure on the Sea#042.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#043.dst: あー、えっと…それは気にすんな、な？
Misadventure on the Sea#043.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: あれは俺たちの…燃料源だ。
Misadventure on the Sea#044.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#045.dst: おお、それは俺の大砲だ！かっこいいだろ？たくさんの腕を使って作―いや、何でもない…
Misadventure on the Sea#045.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#046.dst: おっ、Snoo が気に入ったみたいだ！
Misadventure on the Sea#046.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#047.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#047.dst: こいつは強いニワトリだぜ、そこは信じてくれ。
Misadventure on the Sea#047.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: 俺はただ…ここで待ってるよ…大砲と一緒に…
Misadventure on the Sea#049.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#050.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#050.dst: 甲板の Honip と話し、次の仕事をもらう

Misadventure on the Sea#051.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#051.dst: おい！船がずいぶん綺麗になったな！
Misadventure on the Sea#051.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#052.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#052.dst: そろそろ休ませてやるか―待て。
Misadventure on the Sea#052.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#053.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#053.dst: ホ、Honip！仲間の一人が、何かすげえ変なもんがまっすぐこっちに来るのを見たって！
Misadventure on the Sea#053.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#056.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#056.dst: わ、分からねえ！よく見えねえが、とんでもなくデカいらしい！
Misadventure on the Sea#056.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#058.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#058.dst: あー…具体的にどこを見りゃいいんだ？
Misadventure on the Sea#058.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#059.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#059.dst: 誓って言う、さっきは海全体が狂ったみたいだったんだ！
Misadventure on the Sea#059.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#060.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#060.dst: これがまたお前らの冗談なら…
Misadventure on the Sea#060.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#063.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#063.dst: 知らねえ、こんなの予定にねえぞ！
Misadventure on the Sea#063.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#064.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#064.dst: 兵隊、お前の見せ場だ！呪文か何かで追っ払え！
Misadventure on the Sea#064.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#065.dst: 効いてるぞ！もう一回だ！
Misadventure on the Sea#065.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#069.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#069.dst: やれると思ってたぜ、ははっ！
Misadventure on the Sea#069.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#070.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#070.dst: 大したもんだ！来い、話がある！
Misadventure on the Sea#070.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#071.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#071.dst: あの化け物がどこから来たかは知らねえが、お前のおかげで消えた。
Misadventure on the Sea#071.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: もう一つ片付けてほしいことがある。例の…ネズミだ。
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#073.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#073.dst: 船倉に来い、道すがら説明する。
Misadventure on the Sea#073.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#074.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#074.dst: どうもこいつは地獄みてえな問題らしい。
Misadventure on the Sea#074.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: そこで何が見つかるか知らねえが、あいつらは普通のネズミ「じゃねえ」。
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#076.dst: だから頼む、中に入って…全部ぶっ殺してくれ、いいな？
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#077.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#078.dst: 兵隊、お前の見せ場だ！呪文か何かで追っ払え！
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#079.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#079.dst: ご自慢の呪文を使えよ！
Misadventure on the Sea#079.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: 今のは…ふう…大したもんだった。
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#081.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#081.dst: さて、もっと大きなお楽しみだ…
Misadventure on the Sea#081.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#082.dst: 何やってんだ兵隊？？仕事の「兵隊」って部分の何が分からねえんだ？
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#083.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#083.dst: 来い、いくつか話をつけよう。
Misadventure on the Sea#083.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#084.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#084.dst: お前にはがっかりさせられっぱなしだ、分かるか？
Misadventure on the Sea#084.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#085.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#085.dst: だが、まだ挽回はできる。
Misadventure on the Sea#085.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#086.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#086.dst: ついて来い、道すがら説明する。
Misadventure on the Sea#086.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#087.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#087.dst: さっきネズミの話をしたろ…あー、ちっとやそっとの話じゃねえ。
Misadventure on the Sea#087.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#088.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.dst: 取り戻す火薬があるんでな、船倉を片付けるのはお前だ。
Misadventure on the Sea#088.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: だから中に入って…全部殺すつもりでやれ、いいな？
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#090.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.dst: さっきみたいなヘマはすんなよ。お前は兵隊だろ。
Misadventure on the Sea#090.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#093.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#093.dst: 兵隊、何かするのはお前だと思ってたんだ、そいつじゃねえ！
Misadventure on the Sea#093.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#094.dst: とにかく、話がある、来い。
Misadventure on the Sea#094.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#095.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#095.dst: もう一つ頼みがある。例の…ネズミだ。
Misadventure on the Sea#095.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: いいか、どうもよくある類の問題じゃねえ気がするんだ。
Misadventure on the Sea#096.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: 船倉に来い、道すがら説明する。
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#098.src: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#098.dst: 時々やけにでかい足音が聞こえるし、すげえ不気味なキーキー声もする…
Misadventure on the Sea#098.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#099.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#099.dst: だから入りたくねえんだが…火薬はあそこなんだ！海賊にゃ必要なんだよ！
Misadventure on the Sea#099.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#100.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#100.dst: だから、中に入って…全部ぶっ殺してくれ、いいな？
Misadventure on the Sea#100.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#101.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#101.dst: いざ勝負。Snoo、お前はそこにいろ！
Misadventure on the Sea#101.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats
Misadventure on the Sea#102.dst: 船倉を探索してネズミを倒す

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: 船倉の Colossal Rat を倒す

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape
Misadventure on the Sea#104.dst: 火薬と導火線で大砲を動かし、脱出する

Misadventure on the Sea#105.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#105.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: あの忌々しい盗人ネズミどもを片付けた？…Colossal Rat だと？
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#107.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#107.dst: よくやった、頼りになると思ってたぜ！こっち来い、これを持ってけ！
Misadventure on the Sea#107.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#108.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#108.dst: とにかく、今は休むなり好きにするなりしていいぞ！
Misadventure on the Sea#108.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#109.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#109.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#110.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#110.dst: あの忌々しい盗人ネズミどもを片付けた？…Colossal Rat だと？
Misadventure on the Sea#110.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: こいつはたまげた！ちゃんと挽回したな、兵隊！
Misadventure on the Sea#111.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#112.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.dst: とにかく、今は休むなり好きにするなりしていいぞ！
Misadventure on the Sea#112.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#114.dst: あの忌々しい盗人ネズミどもを片付けた？…Colossal Rat だと？
Misadventure on the Sea#114.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#115.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#115.dst: そりゃ恐ろしい話だ！しかも一人でやったのか！よし、ほら、これを持ってけ。
Misadventure on the Sea#115.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#116.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#116.dst: とにかく、今は休むなり好きにするなりしていいぞ！
Misadventure on the Sea#116.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#119.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#119.dst: いや、でも船倉ではいい仕事してたぜ！火薬がいくらか消えたけどな。
Misadventure on the Sea#119.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#123.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#123.dst: 現在地を確かめ、島から逃げる方法を探す

Misadventure on the Sea#124.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#124.dst: よう兵隊さん！困ってるみてえだな！乗ってくかい？
Misadventure on the Sea#124.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#125.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#125.dst: さて…行き先は海の中心、{p} だ！さっきまでいた所よりは安全だぜ、へへ！
Misadventure on the Sea#125.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#126.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#126.dst: 景色のいい寄り道をしてたら、あの島にいるお前さんとピカピカの装備が見えたんでな。
Misadventure on the Sea#126.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#127.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#127.dst: で、何があったか聞かせてくれ！
Misadventure on the Sea#127.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#128.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#128.dst: ほう、海賊にさらわれたか！そりゃ災難だ…
Misadventure on the Sea#128.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#129.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#129.dst: 頼れる Seaskipper を避けようとするからだぜ！この辺で信用できるのは俺だけさ。
Misadventure on the Sea#129.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#130.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#130.dst: ま、ひどい目に遭ってなきゃいいが！ほら、お詫びに {p} までタダで乗せてやる。
Misadventure on the Sea#130.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#131.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#131.dst: とにかく、遠くに岸が見えてきた！つかまってな、もうすぐだ！
Misadventure on the Sea#131.speaker: Seaskipper Captain
